_comment: Curated reference videos for threshold calibration. Each entry covers a different signal profile (not content category). Add YouTube URLs and run: npx tsx scripts/calibrate/calibrate.ts

videos.label: energetic-vlog
videos.notes: e.g. MKBHD, Casey Neistat — fast cuts, high energy, pop entrances

videos.label: calm-corporate
videos.notes: e.g. Apple keynote, TED talk — fade transitions, minimal graphics, generous hold

videos.label: product-ad
videos.notes: e.g. Nike, Apple ad — beat-synced cuts, bold typography, high saturation

videos.label: documentary-explainer
videos.notes: e.g. Vox, Kurzgesagt — dissolve transitions, warm graphics, breathe hold

videos.label: music-heavy-broll
videos.notes: e.g. travel vlog, food montage — beat-synced, minimal speech, bold MG

videos.label: tutorial-screencast
videos.notes: e.g. Fireship, ThePrimeagen — mixed cuts, callout graphics, moderate energy

videos.label: talking-head-comedy
videos.notes: e.g. MrBeast, Hank Green — jump cuts, keyword highlights, high humor

videos.label: brand-storytelling
videos.notes: e.g. Patagonia, Airbnb — cinematic, dissolves, subtle MG, warm palette
